GRAMMAR Requests
When we ask people to do things for us, we use
modal verbs like can and could. We also sometimes
use past tenses to sound polite. However, we also
make questions longer using typical sentence
starters.
For example: / was wondering if you could help me
is more polite than / wonder if you can help me. Less
polite than either is Can you help me?
